title: ReviewRequirement
description: The review required for a subject (docs/design/m0/13 "The required review is a graph input"). It is both the params of a review_requirement node, a controller node with no inputs, and the conclusions of the result that node records: the fold refuses a review_requirement result whose conclusions are not its node's params. A review that declares a review_requirement input binds it: the claim fold refuses a requirement whose roster or definition version is not the review's. Comparisons are on the revision (roster and definition), never on a review's computation key.

subject.description: What is reviewed, named by the task's template (e.g. candidate). It names no tree, so a base move does not change the requirement and a valid carry-over survives it.

roster.description: The required reviewers, as a review node's roster (records/review-node-params), with the same checks.

definition_version.description: The definition version of the review kind it requires.

revision.description: The requirement's revision for its subject; a roster change selects a new one (G6b).
